title: Daily Coverage Report
description: Global/core iDoXs report showing as-planned and unplanned daily visit coverage, modeled after legacy rptDailyCoverageReport.php.

source.sql: select top 5000 convert(date, i.VISIT_DATE) as visit_date, pi.DISTRICT_ID as district_id, ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) as territory_id, nullif(ltrim(rtrim(concat('(', pi.TERRITORY_ID, ')', isnull(p.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(p.FIRST_NAME, '')))), '(),') as territory_name, sum(case when floor(convert(float, i.ITINERARY_DATE)) = floor(convert(float, i.VISIT_DATE)) then 1 else 0 end) as ap, sum(case when floor(convert(float, i.ITINERARY_DATE)) <> floor(convert(float, i.VISIT_DATE)) then 1 else 0 end) as up, count_big(*) as all_calls from [dbo].[ITINERARY] i join [dbo].[PSR_ITINERARY] pi on i.ITINERARY_DATE = pi.ITINERARY_DATE and i.PSR_ID = pi.PSR_ID join [dbo].[PSR] p on i.PSR_ID = p.PSR_ID join [dbo].[PERIOD_DEFINITION] pd on pi.[MONTH] = pd.PERIOD_CODE and pi.[YEAR] = pd.FISCAL_YEAR where pi.[MONTH] = @periodCode and pi.[YEAR] = @fiscalYear and i.VISIT_DATE is not null and i.VISIT_DATE between pd.START_DATE and dateadd(day, 1, pd.END_DATE) and p.PSR_ID not like '%rr143%' and p.PSR_ID not like '%rr123%' and i.TERRITORY_ID not in ('RRICT') and p.TERRITORY_ID not in ('RRICT') {{territoryPredicate:i.TERRITORY_ID}} group by convert(date, i.VISIT_DATE), pi.DISTRICT_ID, pi.TERRITORY_ID, nullif(ltrim(rtrim(concat('(', pi.TERRITORY_ID, ')', isnull(p.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(p.FIRST_NAME, '')))), '(),') order by visit_date, district_id, territory_id

businessFormulas.label: AP / As Planned
businessFormulas.description: Visits where actual visit date is the same as planned itinerary date.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when floor(ITINERARY_DATE) = floor(VISIT_DATE) then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: UP / Unplanned
businessFormulas.description: Visits where actual visit date is different from planned itinerary date.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when floor(ITINERARY_DATE) <> floor(VISIT_DATE) then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: All
businessFormulas.description: Total covered visits for the day/group.
businessFormulas.formula: AP + UP, equivalent to count(*) over visited itinerary rows

scopeRules: exclude legacy test PSR ids rr143/rr123
dataSourceDefinition.notes: Preserves legacy AP/UP/All semantics. The legacy report pivots dates as columns; DoXs2 starts with normalized rows so the UI can render table/pivot later.
